CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_loto_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    auth.role() = 'service_role'
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.profiles p
      WHERE p.id = auth.uid()
        AND p.admin_role IN ('admin', 'analyst')
    );
$function$
